thread:
samir: Vendor ZenoLogix just flagged a customs hold on 12x H100 inbound FRA. Forwarder says paperwork mismatch, hold until broker clears. ETA now 72+ hrs unless we reroute.
elaine: Uh — we needed 8 for the EU Dedicated rollout on Tue. Can we delay the rollout or pull from spares?
kevin: Forwarder offered two options: 1) Reroute to AMS (surface/air mix) ~48-72h, cheaper; 2) Air-divert priority to FRA ~24h but +$18k brokerage/expedite. Carrier AWB: `AWB123-45678901`.
kevin: also: tracking preview -> http://track.example.com/AWB123-45678901 (carrier provisional)
samir: vendor-bot, confirm these are returns or new units? any RMA paperwork affecting customs?
vendor-bot: ZenoLogix note: units marked as "replacement shipment" not RMA returns. Commercial invoice missing HS code for GPUs — broker flagged. No DOA/RMA paperwork required.
anna: If they're replacement/new, firmware parity matters. Some edge fleets require H100 with v1.2 firmware. Can we accept mixed firmware?
elaine: We can't mix for the edge rollout. We need 8 with matching firmware or we risk degraded perf.
kevin: Temp pool snapshot: EU spare pool = H100 x4, H200 x6, loaner H100s reserved for infra-testing x2. So only 4 immediate H100 spares.
samir: Proposal: pull 6 from EU temp pool (we can rebench workloads to accept 2x H200 lower perf), reroute 8 -> AMS and hold 4 in FRA for vendor QA. Vendor covers broker fee for AMS reroute, we cover air-divert cost if we choose that later.
kevin: I can ask forwarder to split: create 8->AMS AWB and leave 4 on hold. They'll need a signed instruction and broker contact. ETA after split ~48h.
vendor-bot: ZenoLogix accepts AMS reroute and will cover brokerage for that lane if Redwood signs the split instruction by EOD. They request a single consolidated invoice with HS code 847330.
samir: Can finance sign today? If yes we'll avoid the +$18k air cost.
elaine: I'll hold the rollout window by 24h, but we need confirmation by 3pm UTC. Can infra accept 6 pulled spares?
anna: Confirmed — we can reassign some non-latency workloads to H200s to free 6 H100s for rollout. We'll create a provisioning ticket.
kevin: Sending split instruction now, will attach AWB and broker contact. Code snippet for reference:
```
INSTRUCTION: SPLIT_SHIPMENTS(ORIG_AWB=AWB123-45678901, TO_AMS=8, HOLD_FRA=4, SIGNER=redwood)
BROKER: FraBroker Ltd, contact: lisa@frabroker.example
```
kevin: forwarder ETA after instruction: 48h.
samir: OK. Created ticket INF-2389 to track provisioning and cost allocation. Vendor agreed to cover AMS brokerage if signed. We pulled 6 from temp pool. Good call. :thumbsup:
elaine: I'll update the rollout schedule and notify product.
kevin: I'll post final AWB numbers once split is processed.
vendor-bot: Forwarder update queued. Will push tracking when split completes.
